description: NIC-less identity CT template — shared host UDS, no Incus proxy, no eth0. Container name = session_id derived from WG pubkey.

image.description: Ubuntu noble amd64 (seed / RO rootfs) — alias 'noble'/'raccoon'
image.notes: Prefer the local alias: fingerprints change whenever the image is re-imported. 3a639373bb7a was the pre-migration seed and no longer exists on this host.

storage.notes: Seed rootfs on btrfs pool; per-identity fstorage.img attached via btrfs device add (not overlay) Pool was 'default' before the 2026-07 provider move; the live pool is '3tched-storage'.

packages.notes: Identity containers are NIC-less. btrfs-progs must be installed before fstorage is attached so btrfs device remove is always available during reprovision and teardown. wireguard-tools is not part of this template.

ghostbridge-socket.notes: Host owns container.sock; bind under /opt not /run (CT /run is tmpfs).

shared_container.registration: createunixsocket / shared_unix_socket — name=session_id, ports metadata only

host_grpc.notes: Host tools only; not bind-mounted into identity CTs by default

fstorage.notes: Preferred persistence model (multi-device on seed). Teardown MUST btrfs device delete fstorage from seed rootfs BEFORE incus delete (see provision script safe_delete_container). ATTACH_FSTORAGE=0 skips add; ATTACH_FSTORAGE_TIMEOUT / DETACH_FSTORAGE_TIMEOUT default 60s/120s.

memory.leaf: single cozo / cognitive store on host fabric

heartbeat.status: spec + server handler in tree; identity CT client not deployed
